name: unifi-security
description: UniFi security operations: traditional firewall rules, firewall groups, zone-based firewall (ZBF), ACL rules, port forwarding, VPN tunnels, site-to-site VPN, and content filtering. Use when the task involves network access control, firewall policies, traffic blocking, or VPN configuration. Zone-based firewall requires UniFi Network 9.0+ and local API mode.
